documents.title: San Francisco Adopted Budget FY2026-27 & FY2027-28 (Annual Appropriation Ordinance)
documents.note: Adopted by the Board of Supervisors 11-0 on July 28, 2026; signed by Mayor Lurie. All-funds total $16,851,826,113; General Fund $6,181,108,843. Machine-readable via the Controller’s DataSF dataset.

documents.title: SF OpenBook — Supplier (Vendor) Payments
documents.note: San Francisco publishes spending, revenue, and supplier (vendor) payments through the Controller’s OpenBook portal — transaction-level disclosure.
